yellow_fill = PatternFill(patternType='solid', fgColor='FFFFFF00')

# Apply styles to all cells A1:C6
for row in range(1, 7):
    for col in range(1, 4):
        cell = ws.cell(row=row, column=col)
        if row == 1:
            cell.font = calibri_bold
        else:
            cell.font = calibri_normal

# Set fills
# A and B columns: no fill
for row in range(1, 7):
    ws.cell(row=row, column=1).fill = no_fill
    ws.cell(row=row, column=2).fill = no_fill

# C1 (title): keep yellow fill
ws.cell(row=1, column=3).fill = yellow_fill

# C2:C6: green fill #00B050
for row in range(2, 7):
    ws.cell(row=row, column=3).fill = green_fill

for row in range(2, 7):

    if store_name and city:
        result = store_name.endswith(city)
    else:
        result = False
    ws.cell(row=row, column=3).value = result

wb.save(out_path)
